We have all come across those in our lives who display the characteristics now
known as Dark Triad Personality. It's a combination of narcissism,
psychopathy, and Machiavellianism. In short, it creates a person devoid of
empathy, and they use manipulation as the preferred tactic to achieve their
goals. They do not feel remorse for their behavior, nor do they typically
learn from their mistakes. The only guardrails are consequences that they
can't avoid with their trickery, and even then, it's more of a containment
system rather than any type of meaningful growth on their part.

We have seen the chaos such individuals sow, how they seem to thrive in such
conditions. We know that they seem to bring out the worst in other individuals
who don't exhibit such cluster b disorders. They simply react to the
surrounding mayhem in a grasping and desperate manner. The best course of
action when individuals like this are in your life is to diminish their
ability to impact you, but this is of course, easier said than done. People
like this are never content, even when they seem to achieve their so-called
goals. It seems that the real truth of their soul is that they constantly try
to establish and create misery in others to match the rot inside their own
core.

We are now seeing what occurs when such personality types are given unfettered
power in government. The many enablers along the way that have simply gone
along to get along have been integral pavers on this path to hell. The types
who were there for Trump, I knew what they were signing up for. These ghouls
paved the way for Trump II, which, of course, is loaded with characters who
suffer the same defining toxic traits that he does. We are seeing the domestic
violence presidency emerge fully formed and grotesque. The culpability lands
on every politician who has diminished the possibility of improving life for
the multitudes, while expanding the horrific accumulation trends of
billionaires. This falls on all of them.

When partners trapped in such situations try to extract themselves, they find
that they are in the most dangerous of times. Dark Triad personalities do not
take rejection lightly and they do seem to enjoy having an enemy to identify
and project all of their own loathsome qualities upon. Sometimes they kill the
individual trying to leave. Another possibility occurs if their focus falls
upon new victims, and of course, in a broad sense, this is just a new tragedy,
not a solution. Think Venezuela, then Iran, then maybe Cuba……

Our current government is operating in the very same manner as a deranged
domestic partner. It's always been this way, to some extent, due to the
inherent nature of power. Those that want it often desire it for all the wrong
reasons and power self-selects for the morally degenerate. The difference at
this time is the lack of limiting influences. We have men who will literally
wear shoes far too large for them to please a strong-arm dictator. One
remembers stories about Stalin and how he would require his men to drink all
night with him, punishing those who tried to substitute water in their
glasses. This is certainly “never be the one to stop clapping first” standard
cult behavior. Humiliation is the goal and weak men who all go along with such
nightmarish clown shows help launch the horrors to the general population.

This would be but a footnote in history if the maniacs at the helm didn't have
at their fingertips the weapons to murder untold millions and crash the world
economy. Many of us would say that this economy, with its cancerous growth
model, needs to be brought down, but few would say that this is the way to do
it. This method will plunge the vast majority into complete and utter poverty
with a Caligula Plus class to lord over it. Palantir tech will be there to
make sure the net is inescapable.

Through all of this, the US has treated its allies with a disgust that
wouldn't even make logical sense to cast upon enemies. It's almost difficult
to imagine how someone could take the helm of the US and bring it down any
more quickly, leading one to question whether it is incompetence or outright
sabotage.

I think the most likely answer is just that this is what you get when you have
such damaged and compromised individuals. They love the murder, the power and
are quite vulnerable to being shoved in certain directions because of the
likely kompromat that is out there. Lindsey Graham went from Trump is the most
dangerous man rhetoric to the seemingly drunk all the time war mongering
lickspittle we see today. If we had these men in our neighborhood, we'd avoid
them on our daily walks. Yet, we have elevated them to power over us. As the
realization that this situation is absurd lands upon the majority, most have
no idea how to combat an enemy such as this- one who occupies the Dark Triad.

Women attempt to flee abusers by running away sometimes, but our nation has
made it impossible to do just that. Like a guy controlling all of the
household funds, citizens have had their finances controlled to the extent
that most can't miss two paychecks before a catastrophic collapse. They
probably can't run off to Portugal in that situation. And like most abusers,
alliances have been severed anyway; they like to isolate and confuse the
victims. If you don't have allies, you don't have a place to run to. Most
Americans truly don't realize at their core how much harder it is to live here
than all the other developed nations, either. This is the dog-eat-dog style of
existence we all have normalized. Americans have been indoctrinated to fear
“socialism” like the battered partner fears the unknown. The abuse you know
versus a mysterious world you've been told exists but can't quite let yourself
believe in because it almost sounds too good to be true.

The US has allowed for an explosion of poverty and accompanying homelessness,
not because the money isn't there to remedy it (it's obviously available to
murder Iranians). No, that money is there, but the feature/not glitch is to
force the citizens into a domesticated state of fear 24/7.

In the past, much more effort was put into maintaining the illusion, in
convincing US citizens that they were at risk from other nations and it was
necessary to go on _Imperial Adventures_. The chaotic and epic losing going on
right now will perhaps pierce the illusion that this type of society can
continue. The very absurdity and accompanying horror are enough to break just
about anything, including our brains. The invasion of other nations before has
been met with acceptance, but this blind trust is eroding.

The end of US hegemony seems near, and the loss of the petro-dollar seems to
be a foregone conclusion. It's like the abuser is about to be served papers,
but he unfortunately still has a massive arsenal.

We are definitely in that most dangerous time when the victim wants to get
away from the abuser. Here is to hoping that when we look back on this time,
it will be seen as the tipping point before a new and better world was born.
The alternative is unthinkable and we must fight it with all we have.
